# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO_ACTIVATED

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** parameter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Activating the TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO gate (setting its knob to ON) will block call entries during bearish trendline breaks, preventing losses on call trades. Based on the existing candidate's analysis, this should capture an additional $165 on J anchor days by avoiding the 5/07 call loser trades (-$45 and -$120) without affecting PUT winners.

## Mechanism

The TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO gate detects a 5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support break (indicating bearish structure via BOS/CHoCH in market_structure.py). When activated, it vetoes any call entry signal occurring when the gate is fired. The gate logic remains unchanged; only the default state of the parameter `trendline_break_call_veto` is flipped from OFF to ON.
